blurb:
This guy has been through it. Peeta was adopted from Mostly Mutts as a kitten, returned when his family's life changed, adopted again, then ended up in emergency surgery after accidentally swallowing a string that wrapped around his tongue and worked its way into his GI tract. He made it through, recovered fully, and is back at Mostly Mutts ready to try one more time. At 5.5 years old and 10.5 pounds, he's a Siamese mix with a lot of love to give and a surprisingly chill attitude about all of it.

He was shy when he first got back to his foster home, which makes sense given everything. But he opened up fast. Now he follows his foster around looking for attention, winds himself around their feet, and basically makes himself impossible to ignore. The listing puts it well: he's as sweet as he is handsome.

Peeta does well with other cats and probably fine with kids who know how to handle a cat. Dogs are unknown, so if you've got one, plan on a slow introduction and see how it goes. He's litter trained and keeps his space clean. What he really needs is someone who's going to be home enough to give him the company he genuinely thrives on. He's not a leave-him-alone-all-day kind of cat.
